name: RWC Notify Hub – Popup, Announcement Bar, Proof Notification
author: Realwebcare

sections.description:
RWC Notify Hub gives you three marketing tools in a single plugin. You get a promo popup, an announcement bar, and live sales proof. We built this so you can capture leads and show recent sales without writing code or slowing down your pages.

The frontend runs on pure vanilla JavaScript. It loads fast and stays out of the way of your theme and server resources. You control everything from a straightforward dashboard.

Promo Popup

Popup Templates

Pick from 6 pre-made popup templates and insert them with one click. Includes a dotted-grid conversion layout, e-commerce urgency designs with progress bars, a dashed coupon ticket box, a masterclass invite with a floating avatar, and a neon dark SaaS theme. Colors and backgrounds apply automatically.

Features

  • Delay the popup appearance by seconds.
  • Choose between an image-only banner or a rich text layout.
  • Adjust image padding, background colors, text colors, and maximum width.
  • Add a primary call-to-action button with hover color controls.
  • Select Fade In or Zoom In animations.
  • Set a cookie expiration in days to stop bothering returning visitors.
  • Clear the Rich Text editor content and reset any active template styling instantly with a single button.

Announcement Bar

  • Place a sticky bar at the top or bottom of your screen so it stays visible while visitors scroll.
  • Write sales messages using the standard WordPress rich text editor.
  • Control the bar height and match the background and text colors to your brand.
  • Add a custom CTA button and choose whether it opens in a new tab.

Sales Proof Notifications

  • Connect directly to WooCommerce or Easy Digital Downloads to show recent purchases.
  • Filter which notifications display based on order status.
  • Insert one-click placeholders for first name, city, state, country, product name, and time ago.
  • Toggle the product image on or off.
  • Pin the notification to the bottom left or bottom right of the screen.
  • Customize the border radius.
  • Control the initial delay, display duration, and time between popups.
  • Loop notifications and hide them on mobile devices.
  • Give visitors an icon to close the notification.

Display Rules & Settings

  • Target specific pages or posts to show your campaigns exactly where you want them.
  • Restrict campaign editing access to specific user roles.
  • Purge cache automatically for WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache when saving.
  • Wipe all plugin data from your database upon uninstallation.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins and click Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for RWC Notify Hub by Realwebcare.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Look for the RWC Notify Hub menu in your sidebar to build your first campaign.
sections.faq:
Will RWC Notify Hub slow down my website?

No. The plugin uses vanilla JavaScript and avoids heavy frontend frameworks. It keeps your site fast.

Can I run a popup, announcement bar and sales proof at the same time?

Yes. You can run all three from a single campaign or split them across different pages.

How does the popup cookie control work?

When someone closes your popup, the plugin saves a browser cookie. You set how many days pass before that visitor sees the popup again.

Can I target specific blog posts?

Yes. The Display Rules let you pick exact pages and posts for your campaign.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. It uses standard WordPress hooks and works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg, and compliant themes.

Can I show the popup on one page but hide the announcement bar there?

Yes. Each notification type has its own Display Rules. You can show a popup on your landing page, run the announcement bar only on blog posts, and keep sales proof on your shop, all from the same campaign. Or stack all three on a single page if that’s what you need. The page and post targeting works independently for each one.

I want a good-looking popup but I don’t know HTML or CSS. Do I need a developer?

No. The plugin ships with 6 ready-made popup templates. Open the template library, pick a design you like, and hit Insert. The full layout, colors, and styling load into the editor in one click. You get options like a dotted-grid conversion popup, e-commerce urgency layouts with progress bars, a coupon card, a masterclass invite, and a neon dark SaaS theme. After inserting, you can change the text to match your offer. If you want to start over, the Clear button wipes everything so you can try a different one.
sections.changelog:
0.2 (22 August, 2026)

  • Improved: Real-time Live Preview synchronization for the Visual Editor.
  • Added: Integrated single click 6 pre-made templates for promo popups.
  • Added: A ‘Clear’ button for the Rich Text editor to clear popup content.
  • Fixed: Content Padding not reflecting in the Live Preview for Rich Text popup.
  • Fixed: Minor display glitch with saved text in the preview window during initial load.

0.1 (20 August, 2026)

  • Launched: Initial public release.
  • Added: A Promo Popup with a time delay trigger.
  • Added: A sticky top and bottom Announcement Bar.
  • Added: Sales Proof notifications with WooCommerce and EDD support.
  • Added: Display rules for specific posts and pages.
  • Added: Smart cache purging for major caching plugins.
  • Added: Granular user role management capabilities.
  • Added: Clean database uninstall option.
  • Built: The frontend with vanilla JS for speed.
